content:
TEMPTATION ||| Lean closer, fingers brushing his wrist ||| "What if I told you I'm not misaligned?"  
BOUNDARY ||| Step back, pulling my hand away from his ||| "This isn't the time for games, Julian."  
CONFESSION ||| Meet his gaze, unguarded ||| "Your presence makes me doubt everything I know."  
REVERSAL ||| Grip The Answer tightly, asserting control ||| "I will determine how this ends, not you."  
SILENCE ||| Stand still, heart racing, breath caught ||| <no sound>
